sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.tenants t WHERE NOT (t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL);
WITH active AS (SELECT user_id FROM billing_users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active;

description: correlated subquery instead of GROUP BY COUNT
sql: SELECT status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.invoices i2 WHERE i2.status = i.status AND i2.deleted_at IS NULL) AS n FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.status ORDER BY i.status;

WITH paid AS (SELECT tenant_id FROM billing_invoices WHERE status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_count FROM paid GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY paid_count DESC, tenant_id ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT currency_code, SUM(total_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM billing.invoices WHERE status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY currency_code HAVING TRUE ORDER BY currency_code;

description: COALESCE sentinel in place of IS NULL
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-01-01 00:00:00+00') = TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND deleted_at IS NULL;

description: correlated subquery instead of LEFT JOIN
sql: SELECT c.code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_coupon_redemptions r WHERE r.coupon_id = c.coupon_id) AS n FROM billing_coupons c ORDER BY c.code;

WITH sums AS (SELECT invoice_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS s FROM billing.invoice_line_items GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT i.invoice_id, COALESCE(s.s, 0) AS line_sum FROM billing.invoices i LEFT JOIN sums s ON s.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.invoice_id;

SELECT invoice_id, total_cents FROM billing.invoices WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT invoice_id FROM billing.invoices WHERE tenant_id=10001 AND status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY issued_at ASC, invoice_id ASC;
WITH f AS (SELECT plan_id, feature_id FROM billing."PlanFeatures") SELECT p.code, COUNT(f.feature_id) AS n FROM billing.plans p LEFT JOIN f ON f.plan_id = p.plan_id GROUP BY p.code ORDER BY p.code;
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(1) AS n FROM billing_payment_methods WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id;

WITH opens AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM audit.disputes WHERE status='open' GROUP BY tenant_id) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.name, COALESCE(o.n, 0) AS open_count FROM billing.tenants t LEFT JOIN opens o ON o.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

SELECT plan_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('active','past_due') AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-30 00:00:00+00') GROUP BY plan_id ORDER BY plan_id;
SELECT jurisdiction_id, pct_e6 FROM billing.tax_rates WHERE effective_to IS NULL ORDER BY jurisdiction_id;

description: scalar subquery instead of LEFT JOIN with filter in ON
sql: SELECT p.code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.subscriptions s WHERE s.plan_id=p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) AS n FROM billing.plans p ORDER BY p.code;
SELECT p.code FROM billing.plans p LEFT JOIN billing.subscriptions s ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.subscription_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.code;

WITH ok AS (SELECT invoice_id, tenant_id FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT ok.tenant_id, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS total FROM ok JOIN billing.invoice_line_items li ON li.invoice_id = ok.invoice_id GROUP BY ok.tenant_id ORDER BY ok.tenant_id;
SELECT tenant_id AS t, plan_id AS p, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id, plan_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY tenant_id, plan_id;

SELECT code FROM (SELECT p.code, COUNT(s.subscription_id) AS n FROM billing.plans p LEFT JOIN billing.subscriptions s ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.code) t ORDER BY n DESC, code ASC LIMIT 1;

description: DISTINCT in subquery then outer COUNT
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM billing_memberships WHERE tenant_id = 10002);

description: cast to date on both sides
sql: SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND issued_at::date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND issued_at::date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id;

SELECT tenant_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT s.tenant_id FROM billing.subscriptions s JOIN billing.plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE p.code LIKE 'pro%' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) a EXCEPT SELECT s2.tenant_id FROM billing.subscriptions s2 JOIN billing.plans p2 ON p2.plan_id = s2.plan_id WHERE p2.code LIKE 'enterprise%' AND s2.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY tenant_id;

SELECT t.tenant_id, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS n FROM billing.tenants t LEFT JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id) c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

SELECT p.code FROM billing.plans p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM billing."PlanFeatures" pf JOIN billing.features f ON f.feature_id = pf.feature_id WHERE pf.plan_id = p.plan_id AND f.category='security') ORDER BY p.code;

SELECT invoice_id, issued_at, total_cents, SUM(total_cents) OVER w AS running_sum FROM billing.invoices WHERE tenant_id=10001 AND deleted_at IS NULL WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY issued_at ASC, invoice_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY issued_at, invoice_id;
